sources.coprHandbook: COPR Entry to Practice Examinations Handbook, July 9 2026 — full 29-page text on file (bcexam-sources/examination-handbook.txt)

common.afterThreeFailsEn: EMALB rule: candidates unsuccessful after three attempts must submit proof of completing a new Board-recognized training program to be eligible to begin the exam process again.
common.afterThreeFailsZh: EMALB 规定：任一考试三次未通过，必须提交新的认可培训课程结业证明，才有资格重启考试流程。
common.afterThreeFailsCoprCaveatEn: Important for PCP candidates: COPR limits you to three attempts within 12 months of program completion, and its handbook states that timelines and attempts do NOT reset after a refresher or after retaking a full program. To write again you must submit an Eligibility Confirmation Letter signed by your provincial regulator (EMALB). So the real path is: fail three times → complete a new recognized program → obtain EMALB's Eligibility Confirmation Letter → reapply to COPR.
common.afterThreeFailsCoprCaveatZh: PCP 考生特别注意：COPR 的规定是「课程结业后 12 个月内最多 3 次」，且手册明写——重修 refresher 或重读整个课程都不会让次数和时限重新计算。想再考必须提交一封由省级监管机构（EMALB）签字的 Eligibility Confirmation Letter（资格确认函）。所以真实路径是：三次挂完 → 重读认可课程 → 拿到 EMALB 签的资格确认函 → 才能重新向 COPR 报名。
common.practicalFailExemptionEn: If you fail the practical three times and complete a new program, you can be exempted from re-writing the written and/or jurisprudence exams — but only if you completed them within 6 months of finishing the new program AND scored 85% or higher on your first attempt. Scoring high the first time is worth real insurance.
common.practicalFailExemptionZh: 如果你是实操挂了 3 次并重读了课程，可以免考笔试和/或法规考——但必须同时满足两个条件：这些考试是在新课程结业后 6 个月内完成的，且你第一次考就拿了 85% 或以上。所以第一次就冲高分是有实际价值的保险。
common.practicalPrerequisiteEn: Practical exams are not scheduled until the written and jurisprudence exams are passed.
common.practicalPrerequisiteZh: 必须先通过笔试和法规考，EMALB 才会为你排期实操考试。

written.providerNoteEn: Administered by the EMA Licensing Branch online — this is BC's own exam, NOT the COPR exam.
written.providerNoteZh: 由 EMALB（BC 发牌机构）自己在线出题和主办——这是 BC 自己的考试，不是 COPR 全国统考。
written.retakeRulesEn: Fail once: re-attempt after 2 days. Fail twice: re-attempt after 5 days.
written.retakeRulesZh: 挂第一次：2 天后可重考；挂第二次：5 天后可第三次（最后一次）。

written.providerNoteEn: The national COPR Entry to Practice Examination, computer-based and written from home under live online proctoring (Meazure Learning / ProctorU). Registration goes through the COPR applicant portal, separate from EMALB.
written.providerNoteZh: COPR 全国统考，机考，在家远程考，由 Meazure Learning / ProctorU 实时在线监考。报名走 COPR 官网的 applicant portal，和 EMALB 是两套报名系统，都要报。
written.deliveryEn: Written from home under online proctoring — you do NOT go to a test centre. Brick-and-mortar test centres exist only in limited capacity for candidates with an approved testing accommodation that requires one.
written.deliveryZh: 在家考，全程摄像头远程监考——不用去考场。实体考场只保留给「申请并获批了需要实体考场的特殊安排（testing accommodation）」的考生，且名额有限。
onlineRequirementsEn: Desktop or laptop only — no Chromebook, tablet, Surface, or phone; Mac or Windows (not iOS).
Install the Guardian Browser beforehand and uninstall all remote-access software (TeamViewer, AnyDesk, etc.).
One monitor only. Internet at least 3 Mbps up / 12 Mbps down; phone hotspots are not allowed.
Webcam that can pan a 360° room scan, plus a hand mirror or second phone to show the proctor your screen face.
Speaker and microphone required, but headphones and earbuds are banned — your ears get checked.
Alone in a private, well-lit room. No public spaces. Standard chair at a cleared desk — not a bed or sofa.
No food; water only in a clear unlabelled glass. No personal paper or calculator — the platform provides both.
Be set up 30 minutes early. Connect more than 15 minutes late and you forfeit the exam and the fee.
The whole session is recorded and stored by Meazure Learning in the United States for 12 months.
onlineRequirementsZh: 只能用台式机或笔记本——Chromebook、平板、Surface、手机都不行；系统必须是 Mac 或 Windows（iOS 不行）。
提前安装 Guardian Browser，并卸载所有远程控制软件（TeamViewer、AnyDesk 等）。
只能开一个显示器。网速至少上传 3 Mbps、下载 12 Mbps，禁止用手机热点。
摄像头要能做 360° 房间扫描；另外要准备一面小镜子或第二台手机，给监考看你的屏幕正面。
必须有喇叭和麦克风，但禁止戴耳机耳塞——监考会检查你的耳朵。
独自待在光线充足的私人房间，不能在公共场所考。坐标准椅子、桌面清空——不能坐在床上或沙发上。
不能吃东西，只能喝无标签透明玻璃杯装的水。不能用自己的纸和计算器，平台内置记事页和计算器。
提前 30 分钟准备好设备。迟到超过 15 分钟直接失去资格，考试费不退。
全程录像，由 Meazure Learning 存放在美国，保存 12 个月，受美国法律管辖。
written.frameworkNoteEn: Transition schedule from the July 2026 COPR Handbook: the September 2026 sitting offers TWO PCP examinations — one built on the NOCP, one on the CPCF — and it is the candidate's own responsibility to apply for the version matching the framework they were educated to. From November 2026 only the CPCF examination is offered. This site's question bank and mock exams follow the CPCF blueprint.
written.frameworkNoteZh: COPR 手册（2026-07-09 版）的过渡时间表：**2026 年 9 月场同时开两套 PCP 考试——一套按 NOCP、一套按 CPCF 出题**，报哪套由考生自己负责，要与你所受教育的框架一致。2026 年 11 月起只提供 CPCF 版。本站题库与模考全部按 CPCF 蓝图配比。
written.format: Two parts of 120 minutes each with one optional 10-minute break between parts. Part 1 cannot be revisited after the break.
written.formatZh: 两部分各 120 分钟，中间可休息 10 分钟；休息开始后不能再回到第一部分。
written.passMarkEn: Standard Score (scaled) — no fixed percentage. Only the Total Standard Score determines pass/fail.
written.passMarkZh: 标准分制（按考卷难度校准），没有固定及格百分比，只看总标准分。
written.feeNoteEn: $650 + tax per attempt (includes non-refundable $150 admin fee), payable to COPR. BC licence fee is separate.
written.feeNoteZh: 每次 $650 加币+税（含 $150 不可退的行政费），付给 COPR；BC 的牌照费另算。
written.scheduleNoteEn: Offered 4-5 times per year. Application closes ~4 weeks before the exam date. Late applications are not accepted.
written.scheduleNoteZh: 一年 4-5 场，报名约在考前 4 周截止，逾期不受理。日程通常提前一年挂在 copr.ca。
written.seatReservationEn: About three weeks before the exam you get an email to reserve your seat and connection time. Miss that window and you forfeit the exam and some or all of the fee.
written.seatReservationZh: 考前约三周会收到邮件，要你预约座位和连线时间。错过这个窗口就作废，考试费可能全部或部分不退。
written.techFailureEn: On exam day a proctor troubleshoots for up to 5 minutes, then a technician for up to 20. If it still cannot be fixed you forfeit the sitting and fee and must rebook — Meazure Learning may charge a same-day rebooking fee. Call COPR at 1.306.545.2677 immediately if asked to reschedule.
written.techFailureZh: 考试当天出技术问题：监考员最多排障 5 分钟，转技术支持最多 20 分钟，还搞不定就作废本场并损失费用，需要重约，Meazure Learning 可能另收当日改期费。被要求改期时立刻打 COPR：1.306.545.2677。
written.resultsEn: Results released approximately 3-4 weeks after the exam, with a competency-area breakdown (red / yellow / light green / dark green).
written.resultsZh: 考后约 3-4 周出分，附各能力域强弱分色报告（红/黄/浅绿/深绿）。
written.rewriteEn: Failed candidates must submit a new application and pay again. Manual score verification available for $200.
written.rewriteZh: 挂科后重考要重新申请重新缴费；可花 $200 申请人工核分。
timelineEn: About 4 weeks out — application deadline on the COPR portal. Late applications are never accepted; the $650+tax fee (includes a $150 non-refundable administration fee) is paid at application.
3-4 weeks out — Meazure Learning emails seat-reservation instructions. You have ONE week to reserve; miss it and you forfeit the sitting and some or all fees.

14 days out — hard deadline: transcript/completion proof (or Eligibility Confirmation Letter) must be in, and this is the last day to cancel with a refund (less the admin fee). Inside 14 days: no refund except documented emergencies.
Exam day — be set up 30 minutes early; connecting more than 15 minutes late shows the exam as expired and forfeits everything.
3-4 weeks after — results released simultaneously across Canada with the colour-banded standard score report. Do not email COPR or Meazure for early results.
timelineZh: 考前约 4 周——COPR 官网申请截止，逾期一律不收；报名时付 $650+税（内含 $150 不可退管理费）。
考前 3-4 周——Meazure Learning 发座位预约邮件，**只有一周时间完成预约**；错过即弃考，费用部分或全部损失。
考前 14 天——硬节点：成绩单/结业证明（或 Eligibility Confirmation Letter）必须交齐；这也是能退费取消的最后一天（扣管理费）。14 天以内取消不退费，除非有证明的紧急情况。
考试日——提前 30 分钟就位；迟到超 15 分钟考试显示 expired，全部作废。
考后 3-4 周——全国同步放榜，附四色分域标准分报告。别写邮件催成绩。
written.afterFailEn: If you fail: a Manual Verification (mechanical rescore, $200 non-refundable for PCP, no review of your answers) is available in the portal; a formal appeal reviews process irregularities only — exam content is never reviewable, and you must show the irregularity materially affected your performance. Rewriting means a fresh application and full fee. Electronic certificates live under My Documents in the portal (replacement of an old hard copy: $75).
written.afterFailZh: 挂科之后：可在 portal 购买 Manual Verification（机械复核分数，PCP $200 不退，不会重看你的作答内容）；正式申诉只审「考试过程是否有违规」，**考题内容永远不可申诉**，且要证明该违规实际影响了你的成绩。重考=重新申请+全额缴费。电子证书在 portal 的 My Documents 下载（补发旧纸质证书 $75）。
written.securityEn: The Statement of Understanding you sign is permanent: exam content stays confidential even after the exam — discussing questions with anyone (past or future candidates included) or memorizing/recording items is a breach. Penalties: results invalidated while still counting as an attempt, fees forfeited, and your provincial regulator is notified.
written.securityZh: 签署的保密声明是永久生效的：考试内容在考后依然保密——与任何人讨论考题（包括考过的和还没考的）、背题记题都算违规。后果：成绩作废**但仍计一次尝试**、费用没收、通报省监管机构。
written.standardSettingEn: The pass mark comes from the Modified Angoff method / statistical equating — measured against a fixed entry-level standard, never a bell curve. New questions are seeded into each sitting unscored while being psychometrically evaluated.
written.standardSettingZh: 及格线由 Modified Angoff 法/统计等值确定——对照固定的入门水平标准，**不设曲线不排名**。每场都混入新题试测，不计分。

jurisprudence.retakeRulesEn: Fail once: retry any time. Fail twice: wait 5 days before the third and final attempt.
jurisprudence.retakeRulesZh: 挂第一次：随时重考；挂第二次：等 5 天后进行第三次也是最后一次。
jurisprudence.scopeEn: BC law and policy for EMAs: Emergency Health Services Act, EMA Regulation (incl. Schedule 1/2 scope of practice), Board policies, professional conduct.
jurisprudence.scopeZh: 考 BC 的急救人员法规：Emergency Health Services Act、EMA Regulation（含 Schedule 1/2 执业范围）、Board 政策、职业行为。

practical.structureEn: Two scenarios: one medical call and one trauma call, randomly selected from the evaluation bank.
practical.structureZh: 两场场景考：1 个 medical（内科）+ 1 个 trauma（创伤），从官方场景库随机抽取。
practical.scoringEn: Deduction-based: you start at 100% and deductions are taken for each deficiency, weighted by severity (Major/Moderate/Minor). 70% or higher passes.
practical.scoringZh: 扣分制：100% 起步，按缺陷严重度（Major/Moderate/Minor）逐项扣分，剩 70% 以上过关。
practical.mustPerformEn: You must physically perform actions — stating what you would do is not enough. Narrate while you work.
practical.mustPerformZh: 必须动手做出来，只嘴说不算；边做边口述你的思路。
practical.remedialEn: Fail the medical scenario → assigned another medical; fail trauma → another trauma.
practical.remedialZh: 挂 medical 补 medical，挂 trauma 补 trauma。
practical.reviewEn: One clinical review may be requested within 5 days of the exam date.
practical.reviewZh: 对结果有异议可在考后 5 天内申请一次复核（仅一次）。
practical.accommodationsEn: No accommodations are available for practical examinations.
practical.accommodationsZh: 实操考试不提供任何特殊安排（accommodation），必须能实际完成全部技能。
